description: This file contains the implementation of the OLE class within the PhpOffice PhpSpreadsheet project, responsible for reading and parsing OLE container files, managing PPS objects, streams, and associated data structures.

classes.name: OLE
classes.description: Represents an OLE structured storage container, providing methods to read, parse PPS objects, retrieve streams and handle internal data structures.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads an OLE container from a file, initializing internal structures like the Big Block Allocation Table, Short Block Allocation Table, and PPS hierarchy.

methods.name: getStream
methods.description: Returns a read-only stream resource for accessing data at a specific block or PPS.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Retrieves specific data from a PPS, given its index, position, and length.

methods.name: getDataLength
methods.description: Returns the size of data associated with a PPS.

methods.name: isFile
methods.description: Checks if the PPS at a given index is a File PPS.

methods.name: isRoot
methods.description: Checks if the PPS at a given index is a Root PPS.

methods.name: ppsTotal
methods.description: Returns the total number of PPS objects in the container.

methods.name: ascToUcs
methods.description: Converts an ASCII string to Unicode format.

methods.name: localDateToOLE
methods.description: Converts a Unix timestamp to an OLE date string.

methods.name: OLE2LocalDate
methods.description: Converts an 8-byte OLE timestamp string to a Unix timestamp.
